import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Scanner;

public class Main {
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner scanner = new Scanner(System.in);
        String stringInput = scanner.nextLine();
        List<Character> outputList = new ArrayList<>();
        boolean hasAt = true;

        for (int index = 0; index < stringInput.length(); index++) {
            char ch = stringInput.charAt(index);
            if (index >= 2 && index < stringInput.length() && 
                stringInput.substring(index - 2, index + 1).equals("dot")) {
                if (!outputList.isEmpty()) outputList.remove(outputList.size() - 1);
                if (!outputList.isEmpty()) outputList.remove(outputList.size() - 1);
                outputList.add('.');
            } else if (index >= 1 && index < stringInput.length() && 
                       stringInput.substring(index - 1, index + 1).equals("at") && hasAt && index != stringInput.length() - 1) {
                if (!outputList.isEmpty()) outputList.remove(outputList.size() - 1);
                outputList.add('@');
                hasAt = false;
            } else {
                outputList.add(ch);
            }
        }

        StringBuilder finalString = new StringBuilder();
        for (char c : outputList) {
            finalString.append(c);
        }
        System.out.println(finalString.toString());
        scanner.close();
    }
}
